mechanics.claim: The active's effect (damage) is locked in at the start of the cast, and the cast cannot be interrupted, including by the caster's death.
mechanics.quote: Unleashed Power's effect takes place at the start of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Additionally, Unleashed Power cannot be interrupted by any means, including death or resurrection; it will complete so long as Syndra has initiated its cast.
mechanics.quote: Additionally, ''Unleashed Power'' cannot be interrupted by any means, including death or {{tip|resurrection}}. ''Unleashed Power'' will complete its effect so long as '''Syndra''' has initiated its cast.

mechanics.claim: Each sphere is thrown as a separate hit and can be blocked individually; a spell shield only blocks one sphere's damage, not the whole barrage.
mechanics.quote: Spell shield will only block the damage of a single ''sphere''.

mechanics.claim: The number of spheres thrown depends on how many spheres exist (3 conjured plus up to 4 already on the map), directly scaling total damage between the minimum (3 spheres) and maximum (7 spheres).
mechanics.quote: conjures 3 ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}'' and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones

mechanics.claim: The passive reduces Dark Sphere's (Q) cooldown by an amount of ability haste, indirectly increasing Q's cast frequency and thus overall damage output over the fight.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ais|Dark Sphere|Syndra}}'' cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}}.
